title: Pretty Pomeranian boy sulking
description: Whenever we get home from work or running errands Toby would greet us by doing Zoomies because he was definitely happy to see us. However, when we get home a little later than usual or when Toby was not happy about something, he would let us know by not engaging with us. He would stare at us for a while and then look away to let us know how upset he was. He was so adorable 🥹😍
